avis.texte: Pros: very thin, waterproof with strong adhesive, and fairly invisible. I would say they're very comparable from a look and feel perspective to the inkey list pimple patches. I would say that it is the most effective on pimples on the way out (best if whitehead is present) and soothing mild redness/inflammation. It works somewhat on blind pimples but i wouldn't reach for these as a first line of defense. Cons: not the most effective on stubborn/cystic pimples (I wouldn't recommend these for extracting the gunk out). Overall, they're ok, fairly middle of the road at a pretty good price point.
I have to wear these for 2-3 days straight to see a difference. Definitely not fast effective. Definitely other better brands for spot treating.
